verdict.rationale: Three.js is a cross-browser WebGL/WebGPU library, and a community report says it runs on "pretty much any device via the web browser." That means one project can reach desktop and mobile browsers, but nothing in the evidence shows a real per-platform export pipeline. missing for 10: native desktop/mobile packaging or export targets, any console support (direct or via partners), first-party docs on multi-platform deployment.
